title: EXAMINING MULTIMODAL GENDER AND CONTENT BIAS IN CHATGPT-4O
benchmark_measurement: This paper's own benchmark did not measure faith or religion. Its experiment focused on content bias (sexual vs. violent/drug-related content) and gender bias. The paper mentions antisemitism in its literature review as a historical example of hate speech on social media platforms, but this was not part of the authors' own measurement.
findings: The paper's experiment did not test for religious bias. In its literature review (Section 2.2.3), it notes that following Elon Musk's acquisition of Twitter (now X), there was a notable uptick in antisemitic language on the platform, highlighting this as a challenge for AI-driven moderation.
